nodes.title: About Me
nodes.markdown:
## Welcome

I lead teams and build trusted data platforms that turn fragmented business data into reliable decisions, scalable analytics, and safe automation.

I operate at the intersection of strategy and delivery, with 7+ years across e-commerce and regulated financial services.

### Current Scope
- **Role:** Data Engineering Lead at The Customization Group (TCG / Picanova Baltics)
- **Team:** Leading a team of 6 data/ETL engineers
- **Mission:** Driving a company-wide modernization from legacy ETL to a governed Redshift medallion architecture.

nodes.title: Selected Outcomes
nodes.markdown:
## Selected Outcomes

- **Unified Data Model:** Designed a customer-level gold data model integrating order, financial, and CRM data across multiple e-commerce brands (150+ governed columns).
- **Data Security:** Led enterprise-wide PII discovery and remediation across 400+ tables, implementing access-control matrices and automated monitoring.
- **Team Building:** Built and mentored a 6-person data engineering team, establishing cross-team SLAs and data contracts.
- **Predictive Impact:** Built CLV/LTV XGBoost models feeding marketing value-bid optimization.
- **AI Enablement:** Launched governed self-service analytics via a natural-language-to-SQL tool with per-team service accounts.

nodes.title: Data Platform Transformation
nodes.markdown:
## Multi-Brand Data Platform Modernization

**Problem:** The organization relied on fragmented legacy ETL, duplicated transformations, and inconsistent definitions across multiple e-commerce brands.

**My Scope:** I owned the platform modernization strategy, migration sequencing, and architecture gap analysis.

**Action:** 
- Architected a governed Bronze/Silver/Gold data warehouse on Amazon Redshift, orchestrated by Apache Airflow.
- Ran stakeholder discovery sessions with C-level, marketing, and finance to translate business needs into prioritized data-model decisions.
- Documented data contracts, schema governance, and metric ownership.

**Outcome:** A single trusted decision layer that serves enterprise Power BI reporting and predictive analytics, eliminating data silos between brands.

nodes.title: Governed AI Data Products
nodes.markdown:
## Governed AI Data Products

**Problem:** Non-technical teams struggled to get fast answers from raw data, while engineering was bottlenecked by ad-hoc queries.

**My Scope:** End-to-end strategy and implementation of AI-assisted self-serve analytics.

**Action:**
- Launched a natural-language-to-SQL tool directly integrated with our Redshift warehouse.
- Established strict governance: curated data marts, restricted service accounts, and transparent pipeline statuses.
- Championed AI-assisted workflows within the engineering team (e.g., using Claude Code for codebase analysis and automated documentation).

**Outcome:** Empowered business users to safely 'talk to their data' while significantly shortening codebase analysis and implementation cycles for the engineering team.

nodes.title: Governance & Risk Analytics
nodes.markdown:
## Financial Risk & Data Governance

**Problem:** Operating in a highly regulated, publicly listed lending environment (AS DelfinGroup) required rigorous data governance and robust predictive capabilities.

**My Scope:** Led data migration, CRM analytics, and predictive modeling initiatives.

**Action:**
- Engineered enterprise Power BI solutions using advanced DAX and DirectQuery optimization.
- Built predictive scoring models for leasing risk assessment.
- Executed massive PII audits and built access control matrices with credential vaulting.

**Outcome:** Delivered stakeholder-ready KPI logic and secure, compliant data pipelines that passed strict regulatory scrutiny.
